# Mazzone Construction

Mazzone Construction are stonemasons and builders based at 1a Headlands, Kettering, NN15 7ER, United Kingdom.

They repair stone and brick, build extensions and new stone houses, and renovate kitchens, bathrooms, and other rooms. Brando (07860 207117) and Roberto (07925 418257) do the work. Email: mazzonelimited@gmail.com.

Google rating: 5.0 from 20 reviews.
Google profile: https://maps.app.goo.gl/D98Q7wv1BVp49cY17
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mazzone_ltd/

They work in Kettering and nearby towns, including Burton Latimer, Rothwell, Desborough, Corby, Wellingborough, and Northampton.

This site does not use tracking cookies.
